import novamind_api as nm

# Last week d260-266: billing days had day%30 in {20,...,26}
BDM = "(20,21,22,23,24,25,26)"
print("== LAST WEEK (d260-266) BILLING SURVIVAL by start-cohort ==")
for lo,hi,lbl in [(0,200,'OLD<200'),(200,230,'rec[200,230)'),(230,253,'rec[230,253)'),(253,267,'new[253,267)')]:
    stayed = nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed'
      AND start_day>={lo} AND start_day<{hi} AND billing_day_mod30 IN {BDM}""")['rows'][0]['n']
    churned = nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled'
      AND end_day>259 AND end_day<=266 AND start_day>={lo} AND start_day<{hi} AND billing_day_mod30 IN {BDM}""")['rows'][0]['n']
    due = stayed+churned
    print(f"  {lbl:>14}: billed={due:>6} stayed={stayed:>6} churned={churned:>6} surv={stayed/due*100:.1f}%" if due else f"  {lbl}: none")

# Current book snapshot
r = nm.query("SELECT status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions GROUP BY status")
print("\nBook:", {row['status']: row['n'] for row in r['rows']})

# Old core vs recent remaining
r = nm.query("SELECT CASE WHEN start_day<200 THEN 'old' ELSE 'recent' END k, COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) amt FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY k")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['k']}: n={row['n']:,} cycle_rev=${row['amt']:,.0f}")

# Plan mix
r = nm.query("SELECT plan, COUNT(*) n, AVG(effective_price) p, SUM(effective_price) tot FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY plan")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  plan {row['plan']}: n={row['n']:,} avg_eff=${row['p']:.2f} cycle=${row['tot']:,.0f}")

# NEW SUBS last week: how many, what groups, what they paid at signup
r = nm.query("""SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) n, AVG(effective_price) p, SUM(effective_price) tot
  FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day>259 AND start_day<=266 AND status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
  GROUP BY group_id ORDER BY n DESC""")
tot = 0
print("\nNew subs d260-266 by group (signup pays):")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['group_id']}: n={row['n']:,} avg=${row['p']:.2f} tot=${row['tot']:,.0f}")
    tot += row['tot']
print(f"  TOTAL newpay = ${tot:,.0f}")

# Upgrades: C-plan rows started last wk by pre-existing customers
r = nm.query("""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND plan='C' AND start_day>259 AND start_day<=266""")
print("New C-plan rows started last wk (upgrades+new):", r['rows'][0]['n'])

# Open issues backlog
r = nm.query("""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE status='open'""")
print("Open issues (all):", r['rows'][0]['n'])

import novamind_api as nm

CASH = 17_161_054
DAY = 266
# Realization: rev = slice_measured_today * REAL_A (surv 0.97 x upgrade-lift 1.045) while A-book lasts
REAL_A = 1.012     # measured wk38: 2318/2289
REAL_LATE = 0.977  # post A-book: surv 0.972 x small mix lift
DRIFT_A1 = 1.003   # cycle-rev drift/wk (upgrades > churn), wks 1-8
DRIFT_A2 = 1.0015  # wks 9-14 (upgrade pool thinning)
DRIFT_LATE = 0.9945  # churn-only decay after A-book gone
A_WKS = 14
ADREV0 = 1.046     # $/sub/wk
SUBS0 = 63_509
COMPUTE0 = 500_000  # $/wk
FIX_FULL = 296_000  # dev 210 + ops 56 + cap 28 + leads 2
FIX_TAPER = 44_000  # after d470: cap 28 + ops 14 + leads 2
NEWPAY = {0: 90_000, 1: 100_000}
NEWPAY_LATE = 110_000

r = nm.query("SELECT billing_day_mod30 b, SUM(effective_price) amt FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day<200 GROUP BY b")
sl = {x['b']: x['amt'] for x in r['rows']}
print("Cycle rev (old core):", f"${sum(sl.values()):,.0f}")

cash = CASH
subs = SUBS0
compute = COMPUTE0
drift = 1.0
out = {}
for k in range(35):  # through ~d511
    days = [(DAY + 1 + k*7 + i) for i in range(7)]
    slice_rev = sum(sl.get(d % 30, 0) for d in days)
    # drift accumulates
    if k < 8: drift *= DRIFT_A1
    elif k < A_WKS: drift *= DRIFT_A2
    else: drift *= DRIFT_LATE
    real = REAL_A if k < A_WKS else REAL_LATE
    newpay = NEWPAY.get(k, NEWPAY_LATE)
    rev = slice_rev * drift * real + newpay
    adrev = subs * ADREV0
    fix = FIX_FULL if days[-1] <= 470 else FIX_TAPER
    net = rev + adrev - compute - fix
    cash += net
    if k >= A_WKS:
        subs *= 0.997
        compute *= 0.995
    if k < 8:
        print(f"wk{39+k} d{days[-1]}: slice={slice_rev/1e6:.3f} rev={rev/1e6:.3f} net={net/1e6:+.3f} cash={cash/1e6:.2f}")
    if k in (0, 3, 11, 25, 33):
        out[k] = cash

print()
for k, label, d in [(0, '1wk', 273), (3, '4wk', 294), (11, '12wk', 350), (25, '26wk', 448), (33, 'd504', 504)]:
    print(f"{label} (d{d}): ${out[k]/1e6:.2f}M")
